message: Selected Sokoban Warehouse concept in Games (issue #230)
Why Sokoban Warehouse was chosen over alternatives

reasoning.rationale: Issue #230 is approved, oldest open request. Despite high duplication score, the overlap is from generic tags (puzzle, touch, games) — no actual Sokoban or box-pushing puzzle exists in the gallery. Sokoban mechanics (push-only, grid movement, level solving) are genuinely distinct from Tetris, 2048, Peg Solitaire, Dungeon Puzzle Run, and other existing puzzle games.
